pages.text: $(thing)Bowls$() are a versatile tool which can be used to make $(l:cooking/salad)Salads$(), to make $(l:cooking/cooking_methods#pot)Soups$(), to $(l:cooking/decay#salting)Salt$() meat, or to apply $(thing)Powder$() to $(l:craftsmanship/glassworking#coloring)Glass$() in order to change the resulting glass's color.$(br2)Bowls can be made both from $(thing)Ceramic$()―By knapping a bowl out of clay, and then firing them―Or out of wood.

To make a $(item)Salad$() open the interface by holding a bowl and $(item)$(k:key.sneak) + $(k:key.use)$() in the air.$(br2)Bowls can also be placed on the ground like blocks. When placed, they can be filled with any type of $(thing)Powder$() - the results of grinding ores, minerals, or gems in the $(l:craftsmanship/quern)Quern$().

pages.title: 粉末
pages.text: 放置的碗可以盛裝最多16份單一粉末。手持粉末$(item)$(k:key.use)$()點選以放入。空手$(item)$(k:key.use)$()以取出。$(br2)按住$(item)$(k:key.sneak)$()可以一次裝滿或清空碗中的所有粉末。
手持生肉點選裝有鹽的碗可以製作出鹹肉。這與直接在合成格中製作效果相同。
